Figure 82 Achievements 
The achievements page displays your progress in various challenges. There is 
bronze, silver and gold levels. To increase your rank on an achievement you 
must complete its objective as described on the card a certain number of times. 
The progress bar shows your progress from the previous requirement for the 
rank change to the next rank; for example, to get to a silver rank on gems you 
need 500 gems, hence the progress bar is at the start.
